sentences.text:
Ranjeet Agarwal Alias Ranjit Alias ... vs The State Of Jharkhand
on 31 March, 2015
Author: Prashant Kumar
Bench: Prashant Kumar

In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi
 Cr. M.P. No. 2497 of 2014

Ranjeet Agawal @ Ranjit @ Ramesh son of Ramjash
 Agarwal, resident of Rani Sati Market, Jharia, P.O.
 & P.S. Jharia, District Dhanbad ...

Petitioner
 Versus
 The State of Jharkhand ... ... ...

Opp. Party
 Coram: The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Prashant Kumar
For the Petitioner : Mrs. Jasvinder Mazumdar, Advocate

For the State : Mr. H.K. Shikarwar, A.P.P.
 2/31.03.2015

This application has been filed for quashing the order dated 05.07.2014, passed by A.C.J.M.
Dhanbad in Jharia P.S. Case No. 251 of 2013, corresponding to G.R. No. 2550 of 2013

, whereby and whereunder, learned court below took cognizance against the petitioner under Sections 414/273 of the IPC, 30 (2) of Food Safety Act 2006 & 2,3,4 of the Food Safety Prohibition and Restriction Act 2011.

entities.text: Food Safety Prohibition and Restriction Act 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is submitted that the Magistrate has no power to take cognizance of the offence, as under the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006, all the cases are triable by the Special Court.
Accordingly, order taking cognizance is bad.

On the other hand, Sri H.K. Shikarwar, Additional PP submits that as per Section 74 of the aforesaid Act, it is not necessary for the State Government to constitute a Special Court, rather, in some particular case, the State Government has power to constitute the same.
He further submits that as per Section 73 of the above Act, the Magistrate has power to try the case.
Accordingly, there is no illegality in the impugned order.
Having heard the submissions, I have gone through the record of the case.
In view of Section 73 of the above Act, the Magistrate has power to try the case.
Thus, I find no merit in this application.

(Prashant Kumar, J.) Binit Ranjeet Agarwal Alias Ranjit Alias ... vs The State Of Jharkhand on 31 March, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110857882/
